name: Files on this computer
summary: Read and edit files in the one folder you pick.
description: Lets her read and edit files in the one folder you pick on this computer, and nowhere else. Writing and moving files asks you first.
about: The reference filesystem server from the Model Context Protocol project. It only sees the folder you give it.
Sara refuses a folder that is her own data folder or a whole disk. Its code comes from npm (@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem, version 2.1.0); we tested that version.

mcp.name: files

fields.label: The folder
fields.tip: The one folder she may read and change, for example your Documents\Notes folder. Pick a folder of its own, not a whole disk.

guide: Pick the folder, add this tool server, then press Test.

reviewNotes: Started on Windows 11 with Sara 2.57.0: initialize and tools/list answered with 14 tools.
